proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord + passive_modifier family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind. The trait is passive and always-on — no activation cost, no use-count resource, no reset cadence. No existing family (activation, on_hit_trigger, ongoing_effect, etc.) can represent this honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage as a passive species-trait effect
proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom modify_roll_advantage exists but is only wired into MasteryEffect (on-hit riders). A passive_modifier family for species traits would need a SpeciesTraitEffect variant that expresses unconditional advantage on a closed set of saving-throw ability scores, attached to self with no window or resolution intermediary.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

notes: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord — species_trait is not present. ClassFeatureMechanics.activation requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence, none of which apply here. The needed effect (always-on advantage on Int/Wis/Cha saves) maps to modify_roll_advantage in v4, but that atom is only reachable via MasteryEffect. A new SpeciesTraitRecord kind with a passive_modifier mechanics family is the minimum widening required.
